title: Dispatcher contract — verbs, callbacks, stream events
preamble:
# Dispatcher contract — verbs, callbacks, stream events

libds's action-verb dispatch layer. For each DS action verb the dispatcher must:

- Receive the verb's RHS arguments as typed values from
  the Rete action adapter.
- Run the verb's primary effect (assert a fact, route
  to an integrator callback, emit telemetry, etc.).
- Emit the matching `DS_EV_ACTION_*` stream event after
  the primary effect succeeds.
- Surface errors via the engine pending slot per
  [IARC.1.12] / [IARC.2.3].

This doc is the runtime-side dual of [NCBK].
That doc tells integrators *what they can register*;
this doc tells the libds implementation *what it must
do* with each registration.

## What this is not

- Not a tutorial. See [NCBK] for the
  integrator's view.
- Not a compiler-side lowering spec. The DS source
  text → action-atom lowering is per
  [RLOW];
  this doc picks up where a rule's RHS fires an action.
